license.scope_caution: Provider database license is verified at the resource page; upstream lexical provenance remains separately attributable and must not be misrepresented as independently collected ASJP field evidence.

deduplication.canonicalization_rule: JSON/RDF/N3/NT/Turtle/ASJP-text/API/HTML manifestations of this same ASJP Mundari wordlist are one dataset identity, not independent sources
deduplication.independence_rule: ASJP lexical forms derived from Peiros 1998 do not constitute independent corroboration of Peiros 1998 or any source underlying Peiros

scope.use: lexical/linguistic evidence only after item-level extraction and provenance checks

rights_access_consent_culture.participant_consent: not established by provider page; do not infer
rights_access_consent_culture.cultural_sensitivity: lexical entries require screening before any culturally sensitive interpretation

promotion.reason: This run verifies/canonicalizes the source and its reuse basis. Exact item rows and immutable export checksums have not yet been captured in-repository, so no evidence is promoted merely from discovery metadata.
required_next_steps: obtain a permitted deterministic ASJP export representation
extract Mundari items with exact row/concept identifiers
preserve ASJP concept and loan metadata where present
tag each item dependency=Peiros-1998 unless a more specific upstream provenance is demonstrated
screen culturally sensitive lexical material before publication

release_gate_effect: source census strengthened; controlled evidence counts unchanged until exact-locator ingestion
